title: Globally filtered clone instance
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. Suppose $r\le M$ and every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. The globally filtered clone CSP is the instance obtained from the globally filtered clone raw CSP instance by removing its isolated variables.
